title: Invoices, Receipts & Billing History
boundary: Local metadata-only invoice ledger: invoice lines, tax information, explicit payment status, receipt links, download descriptors, reauth-gated refund requests, and reauth-gated dispute filing. No invoice document is generated, no payment provider is contacted, no refund is settled against a real processor, and no raw card data is ever accepted or serialized. Live billing, payment-provider refunds/disputes, public-trust signing, hosted CI, telemetry, hardware, adoption, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL; the product-spec billing contract stays PLANNED_NOT_VERIFIED and no mock balance reaches production state.
